job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer with 2 to 7 years of experience to work on AI models and solutions to support automation and smart applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in artificial intelligence and machine learning, with the ability to design and develop innovative AI solutions.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop AI models and algorithms to support automation and smart applications.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.


Develop and implement data pipelines to collect, preprocess, and prepare data for AI model training.


Train and test AI models using various machine learning algorithms and techniques.


Deploy AI models in production environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.


Continuously monitor and improve AI model performance, identifying areas for improvement and implementing enhancements.




Job Requirements




Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.


Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.


Knowledge of natural language processing, computer vision, or reinforcement learning.


Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems and develop creative solutions.


Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.




About Company



Nitsan Technologies is a leading company in the industry, committed to developing innovative AI solutions that drive business growth and improvement. We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment, with opportunities for professional development and growth.
